card.name: Linking words before supine position
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, the, in) right before the word supine or a body position such as Trendelenburg. Seen in blood pressure instructions and in advice on placing a patient who is hypotensive.

modes.label: Pairing standing with supine
modes.description: The word 'and' joins standing and supine in blood pressure checks.
modes.example: monitor standing<< and>> supine blood pressure and heart rate closely

modes.label: Placing patient in position
modes.description: 'the' or 'in' comes after 'placed in' or 'place patient' and before a body position.
modes.example: the patient should be placed in<< the>> supine position and, if necessary,

card.writes: It seems to raise the chance that the next word is a body position term such as supine, though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a patient position like supine is named.
